title: Peer review of the pesticide risk assessment of the active substance Trichoderma atroviride I-1237
text:
published: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 12:16:24 +0100 Peer review of the pesticide risk assessment of the active substance Trichoderma atroviride I-1237

The conclusions of the European Food Safety Authority (EFSA) following the peer review of the initial risk assessments carried out by the competent authorities of the rapporteur Member State, Italy, and co‐rapporteur Member State, Slovakia, for the pesticide active substance Trichoderma atroviride I‐1237 and the considerations as regards the inclusion of the substance in Annex IV of Regulation (EC) No 396/2005 are reported.
